name: Perceptron Mk1.5
title: Perceptron Mk1.5: price, context window and specs
answer: Perceptron Mk1.5 is a model in Perceptron's Perceptron family, first listed on 2026-09-25. It takes text, image, video and audio in and returns text, with a context window of 36K tokens and up to 8K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $0.15 per million input tokens and $1.5 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are not published, so it is reached through an API.
compare: It is the newest of the 2 versions of Perceptron listed today.
Its input price is the family median, $0.15 per million tokens.
No version in the family has a larger context window.
